我的生活与节日(My Life and festivals): 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:山姆与本的经历和小计划。
The weather was sunny that day. There are always many people at the lantern street. Both of them like rice and coffee. Best of all, we caught a small crab at the beach.
It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner table by bike. Life is full of small surprises. Sam bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. For example, the rice is still in the pot.
Sam is going to travel to Chengdu in August. Sam thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. Sam and Ben had great fun there. The movers carried the piano up the narrow stairs.
Last Tuesday, Sam and Ben went to the family dinner table. Sam borrowed a book about music from the cinema. Sam hopes to visit Chengdu one day.
